items.title: 1.2 Introduction to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

blocks.title: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
blocks.text: The Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) is a framework that defines the processes used by organizations to build an application from its initial conception to its deployment and maintenance.
The primary purpose of the SDLC is to deliver high-quality software that meets or exceeds customer expectations, reaches completion within time and cost estimates, and works efficiently.

blocks.prompt: What is the primary purpose of the SDLC (MCQ 1)?
blocks.explanation: To deliver high-quality software within time and cost estimates that meets or exceeds customer expectations: option (b).

items: SDLC: a framework of processes for building an application from conception to deployment and maintenance.
Purpose: high-quality software, on time, within cost, working efficiently.
